facts.claim: Development started in January 2024.
First internal prototype completed in April 2024.
Beta release scheduled for September 2024.
Beta release had already been released in August 2024 (project update October 2024).
Beta release was delayed until October 2024 because of database performance problems (internal note).
Platform ready for production deployment in December 2024 (December project report).
Production launch postponed until February 2025 (operations document).
Initial team consisted of 12 developers, 3 designers, and 2 project managers.
January staffing report lists 17 members (12 developers, 3 designers, 2 project managers).
Team grew to 21 members in June after four engineers and two testers joined.
Project team consisted of 18 people at its peak (later management summary).
November personnel report lists 20 active members.
Approved project budget was $480,000.
Expenditure of $310,000 recorded by the end of August 2024.
Total spending reported as $365,000 in September financial summary.
Project had spent $410,000 by the end of July 2024 (annual review).
Annual review estimates final project cost will be approximately $525,000.
First performance test average ticket-processing time was 4.2 seconds.
July engineering report average processing time was 3.8 seconds.
August report after database optimization average processing time fell to 2.1 seconds.
Customer-support survey in September reported users experienced average processing time of approximately 5 seconds.
Engineering team attributed performance problems primarily to inefficient database queries.
Unauthorized access incident investigated in October 2024.
Security team incident report states event occurred on October 14 and affected 37 customer accounts.
Management summary states incident occurred on October 12 and affected 27 accounts.
Security team concluded compromised employee credentials were used to gain access.
No evidence of customer password theft was found according to the security report.
Product manager's final update describes the project as successfully completed in December 2024.
Engineering note from December states that several critical performance issues remained unresolved.
Operations document says production launch was postponed until February 2025.
